cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Interesting' isn't audition feedback. Give me one thing to keep and one to change, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I'm trying to encourage you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make the encouragement usable. Start with the singing, then the dancing. Please don't skip the part that made you wince.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your singing was better than your dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Better is a comparison, not a diagnosis. Was I late on the turns or unable to do them? I need to know what you're protecting me from.

reason: Make standards for usable feedback drive successive probes; remove the detachable shoes punchline while keeping sibling care as B's motive.
